zh.title: 華信航空花蓮航線擬10月起減班 運能將轉投離島
zh.summary: 華信航空擬於10月起減班花蓮航線，釋出運能將調度至澎湖或金門。
body: 根據中央社報導，由於花蓮航線載客率偏低，華信航空計劃自2026年10月1日起調整花蓮航線班次。民航局日前已同意，在訂位狀況不佳的情況下，華信航空可適度減少班次，並將相關運能轉飛至其他需求較高的國內離島航線。此前，華信航空與立榮航空皆因載客量不佳而申請停飛花蓮航線。
華信航空董事長陳大鈞表示，高雄至花蓮航線初步將由每週7班縮減至5班，台中至花蓮航線維持每週3班，未來兩航線合計每週最少可能僅剩5班。減班後釋出的運能，預計將調度至澎湖或金門航線。其中，高雄—花蓮釋出運能預計投入澎湖航線，台中—花蓮減班釋出的運能則可能投入金門航線。

en.title: Mandarin Airlines Plans Hualien Flight Reductions Starting October
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines plans to reduce its Hualien flights in October, redirecting capacity to offshore islands.
body: According to Central News Agency, Mandarin Airlines plans to reduce flights on its Hualien routes starting October 1, 2026, due to low passenger load factors. Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration previously approved moderate flight reductions under poor booking conditions, allowing capacity to shift to other high-demand domestic routes. Both Mandarin Airlines and Uni Air had recently applied to suspend their domestic Hualien routes due to poor passenger volumes.

Mandarin Airlines Chairman Chen Ta-chun stated that the Kaohsiung-Hualien route will initially be reduced from seven to five weekly flights, while the Taichung-Hualien route will maintain three weekly flights. Total combined services could eventually be reduced to a minimum of five weekly flights. The released capacity from Kaohsiung-Hualien is expected to be redirected to Penghu, while Taichung-Hualien reductions may support Kinmen route adjustments.

zh.title: 美國航空將在夏洛特測試航班滾動式延誤修正方案
zh.summary: 美國航空將於夏洛特測試基於入境飛機抵達時間更新延誤的系統
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月19日的報導，美國航空計劃針對長期以來的航班滾動式延誤問題，測試一項全新的解決方案。該航空公司將以夏洛特作為首個試點，測試一項基於入境飛機抵達時間來更新航班延誤資訊的機制。
這項測試計畫是在旅客針對滾動式延誤進行多年投訴之後所推出的。美國航空將在夏洛特進行實際驗證，以評估該延誤更新系統的成效，目前尚未公布其他機場或地區的進一步具體營運細節或推廣時程。

en.title: American Airlines to Trial Rolling Delay Fix in Charlotte
en.summary: American Airlines will test delay updates based on inbound flight arrivals in Charlotte.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 19, 2026, American Airlines is preparing to trial a new rolling delay fix. The city of Charlotte will serve as the proving ground for the carrier as it tests updating flight delay notifications based on the arrivals of inbound aircraft.

This test program is being launched following years of passenger complaints regarding rolling delays. The trial is scheduled to begin in Charlotte to test the delay updates, and there are currently no additional operational details available regarding other airports or regions.

zh.title: 波音接近與馬來西亞航空達成787訂單取代A350
zh.summary: 波音接近與馬來西亞航空達成787訂單；預計取代租賃A350客機
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波音（Boeing）目前正接近與馬來西亞航空（Malaysia Airlines）達成波音 787 廣體客機訂單。這筆潛在訂單旨在取代馬來西亞航空目前租賃營運的空中巴士 A350（Airbus A350）客機。
馬來西亞航空在過去近十年間未曾營運波音廣體客機。該航空公司自從退役波音 777-200ER 機型以來，旗下廣體機隊便未再包含波音機型，目前雙方正就 787 客機引進事宜進行溝通。

en.title: Boeing Closes In on 787 Order From Malaysia Airlines to Replace Leased Airbus A350s
en.summary: Boeing is closing in on a 787 order from Malaysia Airlines to replace leased Airbus A350 aircraft.
body: Boeing is closing in on a new aircraft order for 787 widebody jets from Malaysia Airlines, according to a report from Simple Flying. The prospective purchase of Boeing 787 widebody aircraft is intended to replace the Airbus A350 fleet that the Malaysian carrier currently operates through lease agreements.

Malaysia Airlines has not operated a Boeing widebody aircraft for almost ten years following the retirement of its former Boeing 777-200ER fleet. The potential deal would see Boeing widebody passenger aircraft return to the carrier's international fleet after a nearly decade-long absence from its operations.

zh.title: FAA計畫最快週一導入AI系統協助管理空中交通
zh.summary: FAA將於首階段啟用決策支援系統；減輕航情干擾並改善繁忙樞紐規劃
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）計畫最早於週一導入全新的人工智慧（AI）系統，以協助管理空中交通運作。這項措施代表管理機構嘗試採用新技術，來輔助空域交通調度與維運。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，該系統的推廣部署將首先從決策支援階段展開。此階段著重於提供相關資訊與輔助分析，協助管理單位與相關人員進行更具效率的調度決策。
透過決策支援階段的實施，該系統的主要目標在於減輕空中交通所面臨的干擾狀況，同時改善各個繁忙航空樞紐之間的規劃與協調作業。

en.title: FAA to Introduce New AI System for Air Traffic Management as Early as Monday
en.summary: FAA introduces AI decision support system to ease disruptions and improve planning across busy hubs.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is scheduled to introduce a new artificial intelligence system to help manage air traffic as early as Monday. The new system deployment represents a technological initiative to assist controllers in maintaining smooth and efficient airspace management operations across the network.

According to a news report published by Simple Flying, the initial rollout will begin with a decision support phase. This phase is designed specifically to help ease operational disruptions and improve flight planning across busy aviation hubs, providing valuable support for management authorities.
The implementation seeks to address management challenges at major hubs through decision-support tools designed to assist air traffic management.

zh.title: Joby自主飛行Cessna完成3199英里跨美飛行
zh.summary: Joby宣布改裝Cessna定翼機完成跨美自主飛行；安全飛行員全程零干預操作
body: 美國航空科技公司Joby Aviation於2026年9月18日宣布，旗下改裝之Cessna 208B Caravan定翼機（代號J208）已完成飛行距離達3,199英里的美國跨洲自主飛行航程。該架配備Joby自主飛行技術的渦輪螺旋槳飛機自美國西岸加利福尼亞州飛抵東岸北卡羅來納州，整個飛行過程中，機上配備的安全飛行員未進行任何一次控制輸入，全程由自動化系統與遠端飛行員共同維繫飛行作業。
本次跨美展示飛行於2026年9月8日自加州康科德起飛，飛機自行處理包括地面滑行、起飛及著陸在內的所有操作階段。東向航線途中停靠亞利桑那州鳳凰城、德克薩斯州沃斯堡及南卡羅來納州蕭空軍基地，最終自主降落於戴爾郡區域機場（MEO）。抵達東岸後，該機亦在北卡羅來納州小鷹鎮萊特兄弟首次飛行紀念碑附近進行自主低空通告飛行。
根據Joby公布的作業細節，該架飛機是在遠端飛行員監督下進行自主飛行。遠端機長負責管理航務計畫更新，並透過飛機上的無線電設備處理空中交通管制（ATC）通訊；地面監督人員亦可在距離飛機遠達2,300英里之處監控飛行狀態。機上雖設有安全飛行員以備不時之需，但在整體跨洲航程中均未接管控制權。
為發展自主飛行技術，Joby於2024年6月收購了開發商Xwing的自主飛行部門。在進行本次跨美巡迴前，該自主飛行系統已於管制及非管制空域累積超過400架次飛行與800小時自動飛行紀錄。Joby同時正在開發可載運1名飛行員與4名乘客的電動垂直起降（eVTOL）空中計程車，並計畫逐步將Xwing自動化技術整合至該機型中，以實現未來更長遠的自動化營運目標。

en.title: Joby Technology Flies Modified Cessna Caravan Autonomously Across US
en.summary: Joby Aviation completes autonomous transcontinental flight with a modified Cessna Caravan across the United States.
body: California-based Joby Aviation announced on September 18, 2026, that a modified Cessna 208B Caravan aircraft fitted with its autonomous flight technology completed a 3,199-mile transcontinental journey across the United States. Known as the J208, the turboprop aircraft traveled from California to North Carolina without a single control input from its onboard safety pilot, demonstrating fully autonomous navigation across multiple stages of flight.

The cross-country demonstration commenced on September 8, 2026, in Concord, California. Throughout the multi-stop journey, the autonomous system handled its own taxiing, takeoffs, and landings. The eastbound routing included operational stops in Phoenix, Fort Worth, Texas, and Shaw Air Force Base in South Carolina, preceding an autonomous landing at Dare County Regional Airport (MEO) in North Carolina. Following its arrival on the East Coast, the aircraft also conducted an autonomous low pass near the Wright brothers' First Flight Monument in Kitty Hawk.

Operational oversight during the flight was provided by a remote pilot who acted as the pilot in command. From ground monitoring stations located as far as 2,300 miles away, personnel managed flight-plan updates and conducted air traffic control communications via the aircraft's onboard radios. Although a safety pilot remained inside the cockpit throughout the mission to take control if necessary, Joby confirmed that no manual control interventions were required.

The autonomous technology relies on capabilities acquired when Joby purchased the autonomous flight division of developer Xwing in June 2024. Prior to the coast-to-coast tour, the system had logged more than 400 flights and 800 automated flight hours across controlled and uncontrolled airspace. Joby plans to leverage this automation technology to enhance future capabilities for its electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) air taxi, which is currently designed to carry one pilot and four passengers.

zh.title: 利比亞米蘇拉塔噴射機降落偏離跑道燒毀 檢方涉酒駕扣留兩機師
zh.summary: BKNJET噴射機於米蘇拉塔降落偏離跑道燒毀；利比亞檢方指控機師酒駕
body: 利比亞檢察官表示，兩名飛行員於2026年9月14日涉嫌在酒醉狀態下駕駛賽斯納引用緯度（Cessna Citation Latitude）商務噴射機，並於米蘇拉塔國際機場（MRA）降落時發生墜機事故，檢察機關已正式下令將兩名飛行員予以審前羈押。
涉事飛機的土耳其營運商BKNJET對飛行員已被逮捕的相關報導提出異議，並表示公司方面截至目前尚未收到任何支持飲酒指控的查證結果或官方證明文件。BKNJET補充說明，兩名飛行員當時正在配合當局進行訊問與事實釐清。
這架國籍標誌與登記號碼為TC-AKF的商務噴射機，當時載有兩名飛行員及一名空服員由伊斯坦堡飛抵米蘇拉塔，預計接載預定乘客。飛機於降落過程中偏離跑道並遭大火燒毀，所幸機上全數三名機組人員均在事故中順利生還。
根據利比亞國家通訊社（LANA）轉述的檢方聲明，調查人員在事故發生24小時後對機組人員進行訊問，並就涉嫌醉酒駕駛的相關事證質問飛行員。檢察機關指控飛行員忽視航空安全法規，嚴重危及機組人員、航空器及機場地面人員的安全。
利比亞民航局發表聲明指出，調查人員已成功尋獲飛機的駕駛艙語音記錄器與飛行資料記錄器，後續將送往專業機構進行解碼。調查小組已對機組人員及航空交通管制人員進行訪談，收聽塔台錄音並追蹤飛機於15號跑道的著陸軌跡，殘骸目前已移入封閉棚廠進行檢驗。

en.title: Libyan Prosecutors Detain Pilots After Cessna Citation Runway Excursion in Misrata
en.summary: BKNJET Cessna Citation Latitude crashes in Misrata; Libyan prosecutors hold pilots over alleged intoxication.
body: Libyan prosecutors announced that two pilots were ordered into pretrial detention after allegedly operating a Cessna Citation Latitude while intoxicated prior to a crash at Misrata International Airport (MRA) on September 14, 2026. Authorities stated that the investigative findings prompted the detention order as legal proceedings into the aviation occurrence continue.

The aircraft's Turkish operator, BKNJET, disputed reports that the flight crew members had been arrested and stated that it has received no verified documentation or evidence supporting the allegations of alcohol consumption. The company confirmed that both pilots were undergoing official questioning by local authorities regarding the circumstances surrounding the flight.

Registered as TC-AKF, the business jet had flown into Misrata from Istanbul with two pilots and a flight attendant on board to collect passengers. During the landing roll, the aircraft veered off the runway and was subsequently destroyed by fire; however, all three crew members survived the incident without loss of life.

In an announcement carried by Libya's state news agency, LANA, prosecutors stated that investigators questioned the crew 24 hours after the accident and confronted the pilots with evidence of operating while intoxicated. Prosecutors accused the flight crew of disregarding aviation safety rules and endangering people aboard the aircraft and on the ground.

According to a statement from the Libyan Civil Aviation Authority, investigators have recovered both the cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder, which will be sent to a specialist facility for decoding. The accident investigation team has interviewed crew members and air traffic control personnel, reviewed tower audio, traced the jet's path on Runway 15, and moved the wreckage to an enclosed hangar.

zh.title: 丹麥F-35戰機首度降落格陵蘭 參與北約北極哨兵演習
zh.summary: 皇家丹麥空軍兩架F-35A戰機於9月16日首度降落格陵蘭康格魯斯瓦克機場。
body: 皇家丹麥空軍兩架F-35A戰鬥機於2026年9月16日順利降落位於格陵蘭西部的康格魯斯瓦克機場（SFJ）。根據丹麥武裝部隊公布的資訊，這是丹麥所屬的F-35戰鬥機首次在格陵蘭島降落，達成該國空中力量於北極地區營運的重要里程碑。
這兩架丹麥F-35A戰鬥機在完成格陵蘭上空的多國聯合訓練任務後，降落於康格魯斯瓦克機場的聯合北極司令部設施。當日一同降落的還包括四架美國空軍F-16戰鬥機與兩架加拿大空軍F-18戰鬥機。丹麥戰機是從冰島的凱夫拉維克空軍基地起飛部署，而美加兩國的戰機則是由加拿大的鵝灣起飛，各編隊飛行數百公里後於格陵蘭會合。
在從冰島飛往格陵蘭的長途空中航程中，一架法國空中巴士A330 MRTT多用途空中加油運輸機為丹麥F-35A戰機提供了空中加油支援。空中管制與戰術協調由北約空中預警與管制系統（AWACS）飛機負責，丹麥空軍的一架挑戰者（Challenger）飛機則在任務期間提供搜救支援備勤。
本次演練屬於北約「北極哨兵」（Arctic Sentry）戰備強化行動的一部分。該行動由北約於2026年2月啟動，並由諾福克聯合部隊司令部主導，旨在加強北約盟國在北極及高北地區的戰略姿態與聯合協調能力，持續架構區域內多國空軍力量的聯合演訓活動。
丹麥過去曾將F-16戰鬥機部署於康格魯斯瓦克機場執行北極任務，但隨著該國於2026年1月18日正式退役F-16機隊，F-35A戰機已成為皇家丹麥空軍唯一的戰鬥機機種。儘管丹麥F-35戰機先前曾自冰島凱夫拉維克基地起飛、沿格陵蘭東海岸執行空中巡邏，但在此次演習前從未於格陵蘭島上降落。

en.title: Danish F-35A Fighters Land in Greenland for First Time in NATO Exercise
en.summary: Royal Danish Air Force F-35A fighters landed in Greenland on September 16 during NATO exercise.
body: Two Royal Danish Air Force F-35A fighters landed at Kangerlussuaq Airport (SFJ) in western Greenland on September 16, 2026. According to official information from the Danish Armed Forces, this operational arrival marks the first time that Danish F-35 aircraft have touched down on the island of Greenland.

The two Danish F-35A fighters landed at the Joint Arctic Command facility at Kangerlussuaq together with four United States F-16 fighters and two Canadian F-18 fighters following a multinational military training mission executed over Greenland. The aircraft from each nation covered several hundred kilometers to form up over Greenland, with the Danish fighters deploying from Keflavik Air Base in Iceland and the US and Canadian aircraft launching from Goose Bay in Canada.

Support operations for the long-distance flight included aerial refueling provided by a French Airbus A330 MRTT tanker transport during the transit leg from Iceland. Tactical airspace surveillance and coordination were conducted by a NATO airborne warning and control system (AWACS) aircraft, while a Danish Challenger aircraft provided search and rescue cover throughout the operation.

The multinational mission took place under Arctic Sentry, an enhanced vigilance activity launched by NATO in February 2026 and led by Joint Force Command Norfolk. The overall initiative is designed to strengthen alliance coordination and posture across the Arctic and High North regions, having previously framed allied training events across the Nordic operational theater.

Denmark previously stationed F-16 fighters at Kangerlussuaq Airport for Arctic operations prior to retiring its F-16 fleet on January 18, 2026, which left the F-35A as the Royal Danish Air Force's sole fighter aircraft model. Although Danish F-35 fighters had previously conducted aerial patrols along Greenland's eastern coast from Keflavik, they had not landed on Greenland before this mission.

zh.title: 美國FAA豁免波音777F燃油效率新規准予生產35架
zh.summary: 美國FAA豁免波音777F燃油限制；允許其在2031年前生產35架
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）證實，已批准波音（Boeing）的豁免申請，免受2028年起實施的新燃油效率法規限制。此豁免允許波音在2028年1月1日至2031年1月1日期間，為最多35架新造777F貨機取得首張適航證書。
根據FAA於2024年發布的新規，2028年後製造的飛機須符合更嚴格的燃油效率限制。波音指出其下一代777-8F貨機預計要到2029年左右才能投入服務，因此需要此項豁免以避免在過渡期內造成市場供應中斷。
本站先前報導，衣索比亞航空（Ethiopian Airlines）於2026年9月初正與波音商談購買至多10架貨機，其中包含2架現行777F貨機。

en.title: FAA Grants Boeing Exemption From Fuel-Efficiency Rules to Build 35 777F Freighters
en.summary: The FAA granted Boeing a fuel-efficiency exemption to deliver thirty-five 777F freighters through January 2031.
body: On September 16, 2026, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted Boeing a waiver from future fuel-efficiency regulations. This exemption allows the planemaker to obtain airworthiness certificates for up to 35 newly built 777F freighters from January 1, 2028, through January 1, 2031.

Under the FAA's 2024 ruling, aircraft built after 2028 must adopt enhanced fuel-efficiency technologies. Boeing petitioned for the waiver because its replacement model, the 777-8F, is not projected to enter service until approximately 2029, making the exemption critical to avoiding market supply gaps.
Previously, on September 2, 2026, Ethiopian Airlines was reported to be negotiating a deal to purchase up to 10 Boeing freighters, which is expected to include two current-generation 777Fs.
